parsed_output.deduplication_rule: Merge citations sharing identical normalized DOI (lowercase, no resolver prefix). Retain the first encountered ID as the canonical reference.

workflow_steps.verification: Ensure all DOIs are lowercase and stripped of 'https://doi.org/' prefixes; set to null if input is null.
Group citations by normalized DOI value. Flag groups with size > 1.
Check for null values in 'doi', 'journal', and 'year' fields. Record missing keys per citation ID.

additional_controls: No external network calls or API lookups are permitted.
All processing is performed strictly on the provided local synthetic input.
No destructive actions or file modifications are executed.

hard_checks.check: missing journal and year on C4

evidence.verification: Ensure all DOIs are lowercase and stripped of 'https://doi.org/' prefixes; set to null if input is null.
Group citations by normalized DOI value. Flag groups with size > 1.
Check for null values in 'doi', 'journal', and 'year' fields. Record missing keys per citation ID.

acceptance.aggregation: all hard checks must pass; quality checks are non-compensating
